concept.title: Task Topic
concept.shortdesc: A task topic documents a procedure that a user performs to complete a specific goal.

conbody.p: A task topic documents a procedure that a user performs to complete a specific goal. The converter classifies a section as task when the heading or opening sentence contains an imperative verb — such as install, configure, set, create, enable, or deploy — and a numbered list is the primary body content. The generated topic uses <task> with <taskbody>, and the body is partitioned automatically: pre-step content maps to <prereq> or <context>, numbered items map to <steps><step><cmd>, and any trailing Normal paragraphs map to <result>.
